status: Partial stationary shooting-hazard implementation; no full acceptance claimed.
implemented: Dedicated aimed/triple blood volleys, real ballistic explosive vomit, fixed streams, alternating cardinal/diagonal crosses, fixed Brimstone beams and continuously rotating flickering Stone Eye beams.

Explicit ordinary-combat/pressure-plate/always-on shutdown policy; actual player contact presses plates; ordinary foes still gate combat rooms; plate-only and objective-free runtime contexts are distinct.

Source stationary hazards remain physically solid and inactive after combat. Cleared Stone Eyes disappear on re-entry. Exceptional destruction removes collision and respawns ordinary statues on re-entry without ordinary kill/loot rewards.
Separate navigation-only footprints prevent walking/dodge/flight through statues while actual projectile collision reaches the rendered stone body. Mouse paths route around them.

A separate seeded pool supplies at most one optional legal hazard in combat rooms in bands 1–3. Existing ordinary enemy choices are unchanged. Persistent turrets receive an optional reachable plate; no ordinary pool entries for always-on variant 11.

adaptations.timings: Cadence/windup/speed/damage/laser widths/turn rate and ballistic gravity are explicit local tuning in statues.mechanics, not extracted native AI constants.
adaptations.hp: 20 source HP becomes 64 local HP; 1 source HP becomes 3.2. Ordinary invulnerability makes these bookkeeping values, not standard weapon durability.
adaptations.subtypes: Cross subtype 1 uses an initial diagonal phase as a declared interpretation of the alternate animation name; exact native startup is unverified. Variant 11 never disables in this debug controller; source pressure-plate precedence remains unresolved.
adaptations.placement: Local room chances are 25/30/35 percent in bands 1/2/3. One added hazard is separate from the existing ordinary threat budget. Every proposed footprint must preserve door/objective navigation and avoid roads/river banks; failed proposals are omitted. Generated statues currently receive a hard-coded 1.4-second initial grace before their configured attack cadence; isolated timing fixtures explicitly start with zero cooldown.
adaptations.pressure_plates: Persistent turrets in ordinary combat rooms have an optional deactivation plate. The runtime supports plate-only objectives and objective-free traps, but full new trap-room generation is not enabled here.
adaptations.visuals: Original-style procedural stone bodies, green Vomit stone, triple apertures, fixed-shooter crack and closed inactive face. Body hit boxes and movement footprints use the displayed cube dimensions; these are not source sprites.

unresolved: Chaos Card, Euthanasia, Little Horn, Infestation 2, Dead Eye, Fire Mind and D10-specific behavior need real item/effect producers; generic damage/death hooks are not those item implementations.
Cross Grimace bombed-door early-deactivation quirk and variant 11 plate precedence remain unverified/unimplemented. Variant 11 requires dedicated trap routing before gameplay reachability acceptance.
Vomit replacement probability/context, native random shot intervals, exact projectile/laser dimensions, hitbox and phase timings remain unmeasured.
Gaping Maws, Quake Grimaces and Bomb Grimace supply/dedicated encounter dependencies remain source-only.
Mixed-room balance, all-camera readability and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
